title: World Bloom — Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future — Episode6 Making Music Together

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future
meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGER version of Leo/need's debut song is generating buzz, and Ichika and the others couldn't be happier. As the band renews their vow to make it as pros, a new area appears in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I should be able to head out now that I've finished putting everything away.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Nice work, Hinomori.
Thanks for helping out again today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, hi.
Thank you for having me again.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
How's your band been doing lately?
You must be really busy now that you've had your big debut.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, though things have been ramping up slowly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I'm sorry about all the trouble I've been causing you. I just haven't been able to work as much...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I'm just happy that I get to see someone I know become a success! Let me know if you have any questions regarding shifts and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Oh, Hinomori...!
Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I'm glad we bumped into each other. We didn't know you were scheduled to work today.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Wait, you both came?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Actually, yeah.
We wanted to discuss something regarding our next show.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But if Hinomori's on her way out, mind if we talked to her for a bit first?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Haha, sure thing. I'll be taking care of some stuff over there, so let me know once you're done chatting.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Umm... Sorry, we didn't mean to startle you or anything...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's okay. I was just a bit surprised, is all.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: And congratulations on your big debut, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Hehe. You don't know how much Iori's been wanting to congratulate you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I told her that she should just shoot you a message, but she was so adamant about congratulating you in person.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hey, she doesn't need to know all that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
Again, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
You girls made a really good song.
Your bass sounded so alive.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I guess it's proof that Leo/need allows you to shine at your brightest.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And thank you again, for everything...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We wouldn't have been able to go pro if it weren't for you two, Iori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you hadn't invited me to join your band back then, I don't think we would've ever decided to try to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because me leaving Leo/need had become a real possibility...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
I see...
That certainly was a path you could've taken.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But even if you did decide to leave, I doubt it would've been easy for you to actually do it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I mean, deep down, Hinomori, you've always wanted to keep playing music with your friends, right?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: It was written all over your face back then.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Anyway, the hard part starts here.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Because you have to keep getting better in order to stay competitive. And we're not about to let you hog all the glory.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We promise to keep doing our best to keep up with STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Our song's playing again...
It's coming from that billboard.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The music video turned out so well. We all look so serious...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But even if you did decide to leave, I doubt it would've been easy for you to actually do it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I mean, deep down, Hinomori, you've always wanted to keep playing music with your friends, right?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: It was written all over your face back then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (When I was in junior high, I tried forming a band with other people... But it didn't go well.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'd convinced myself somewhere along the way that my bandmates had to be as serious as I was.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Otherwise, we wouldn't be able to succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That's why... When Ichika and Saki wanted to get the band back together, I thought it wouldn't work out.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I mean, they didn't initially have careers as musicians on their radar.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't come crying to me later saying you can't hack it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Join your band, yeah. If that's okay with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (In the end, I realized that I wanted to keep playing with them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My desire to go pro had always been strong...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But so was my desire to keep playing with them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO...!
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I was going to ask if you'd come over and play your bass with me...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<But I'm sorry...
I overheard your conversation at the live house.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But that's okay.
Nothing we talked about needed to stay hidden or anything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More importantly, I do feel like practicing, so would you like to join me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wait, now? But it's getting pretty late...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know. But I really feel like playing my bass right now. Just for a little bit?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Okay, understood...
Then, I'll meet you in SEKAI and... Oh...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<That reminds me...
Have you heard about the new area that appeared over here...?>
